modules.module_title: Prepare daily work plan and allocate resources and tasks

pcs.pc_description: Obtain order details such as origin/destination country, shipment date, nature of cargo that needs to be cleared.
Budget and allocate the requisite resources for different tasks.
Assign specific tasks to team members based on their skills and experience, ensuring that each person is responsible for the right part of the shipment process.
Delegate tasks such as coordinating shipments, preparing documentation, managing customer queries, and ensuring that deadlines are clear, and expectations are set.
Develop daily work plan factoring in priorities and exceptions.
Get the work plan approved by the manager and allocate tasks to workers and executives.

modules.module_title: Monitor daily operations and resolve escalated issues

pcs.pc_description: Escalate the matter to the manager in case of anomalies in customs papers or when additional support is required.
Coordinate with other departments, external agents and customs officials to resolve pending cases and get additional documents, where required.
Conduct daily reviews of the teams concerning the allocated work, checking for accuracy in documentation and compliance with regulations and providing feedback when necessary.
Conduct regular inspections and collect feedback to identify priorities and bottlenecks.
Monitor the daily work to facilitate smooth documentation and operation.
Identify any issues or delays and take corrective actions to resolve them.
Monitor skill gaps within the team and offer training to improve knowledge and capabilities.

modules.module_title: Coordinate with internal and external entities

pcs.pc_description: Connect with the manager, office supervisors and executives daily to obtain the work requirements and feedback.
Coordinate with the operations team to ensure that all logistics processes such as booking shipments, managing inventories, and arranging transportation are executed efficiently.
Work closely with the sales team to gather information about customer requirements and communicate specific shipping details, timelines, and expectations to the operations team.
Manage relationships with other freight forwarders, third-party logistics providers (3PL), and agents in other countries to ensure seamless handling of shipments across borders.
Coordinate with insurance companies to ensure that shipments are adequately insured against damage or loss during transit.
Communicate directly with clients to understand their shipping needs, provide updates on the status of shipments, and address any concerns regarding delivery schedules, damages, or lost goods.
Coordinate with the office executive to obtain the necessary documentation, as well as highlight priorities and exceptions.
Correspond with freight agents and clients in case of any additional information requirement.

modules.module_title: Plan and supervise daily freight operations

pcs.pc_description: Plan for daily activities and allocate resources based on priorities and pending activities
Coordinate with stakeholders regarding the on-ground freight requirement
Ensure that the goods/ cargo is inspected while unloading and segregate damaged goods
Communicate with the transport supervisor to arrange for the cargo transportation
Cross-check and verify if all approved documents are received and submitted to the documentation executive for filing, including those submitted by the transporter for cargo movement
Plan for high-priority freights and other delayed shipments by allocating alternative/additional resources
Conduct random inspection of cargo for damages
Resolve queries and bottlenecks in operations and take appropriate action on escalations raised by the customers
Provide end of the day reporting to the manager
Verify and approve daily invoicing and exemption cases
Check for errors in calculating taxable value and tax value after applying the applicable rate of GST
Check if the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) is chargeable on the invoices raised for the export of goods/services
Check if GST is payable under reverse charge in case of an unregistered party
Review and approve vendor invoices and ensure that all the mandatory particulars are mentioned on the invoice
Verify if the goods/services are procured from a registered vendor and Check for pending litigation cases under earlier regime
Review sales invoices and ensure the records are maintained properly
Coordinate with the finance department for any updates in GST law
Check that the payment received from the client is including applicable taxes
Assist in verifying and reviewing monthly returns
Monitor maintenance record of taxes paid and acknowledgement of the returns filed

modules.module_title: Interacting with various shippers, agencies and clients

pcs.pc_description: Interact periodically with shipping lines, airlines, and road and rail freight operators to offer effective multi-modal transportation services to customers globally
Coordinate with International Air Transport Association (IATA) agents to collect quotations for air freight
Correspond with the insurance agents to arrange insurance for goods in transit
Coordinate with the transporter for transporting from customs to the place of destination
Inform exporter/importer on goods act, clauses, requirements, export and import restrictions, tariff systems, letters of credit, insurance requirements and other customs-related matters
Offer multimodal transportation services by air, sea and road, ensuring cost-effective and secure solutions
Coordinate with customers to solve any mismatch / deficiency in documents & any other updates regarding shipments
Record and submit copies of bill of lading/ shipping bills to the client/shipper
Make note of any special cargo movement/packaging requirement for the cargo during shipment from the shipper
Inform the shipper about the objection raised by the customs authorities (e.g., incorrect exchange rates, validity period of certificates)
Provide shipment status notification to exporters, consignees, or insurers
Follow up and ensure the importer receives the goods in the place of destination

modules.module_title: Supervise day to day customs office operations

pcs.pc_description: Check that the team accommodates new customs regulations.
Clarify the team's queries regarding the customs clearance process
Check if the classification of the product is under the correct Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) codes and see the associated benefits (under schemes, etc.)
Compute duties and tariffs levied to and from foreign destinations and export schemes and drawbacks
Check for Rules of Origin (ROO) certificate availability and authenticity
Check and file bill of entity (BoE) of the importer shipping bills and Bill of Lading (BoL) for the exporter
Collect debit notes from shipping companies
Verify the documents consigned to assistants for customs processing and clearance
Respond to any queries related to customs documentation
Coordinate and collect duty orders (D.O) and payments

modules.module_title: Arrange documents for the clearance of cargo

pcs.pc_description: Check if clearance of shipment is done on time without delay
Inspect all EXIM documentation as required for customs clearance
Monitor packaging and labelling of cargo
Inspect goods/ cargo while unloading and ensure no damage during the transit
Communicate with the transport supervisor to arrange for the cargo transportation
Coordinate and update the status of cargo in the portal
Cross-check and verify if all approved documents are received and submitted to the documentation executive for filing

modules.module_title: Assist customs official in clearing cargo

pcs.pc_description: Prepare import and export declarations
Liaise with customs and other governing authorities regarding different regulatory requirements
Communicate with customs officials to obtain release of incoming or outgoing freight and resolve delays
Respond to any queries raised by the customs official
Accompany the customs inspector for a random package check, as required
Respond to any objection raised by customs authorities on the cargo and the details
Check if the receiving is taken for Out of Customs charge/ Let Export approval on clearance by customs official
Prepare import and export declarations and process them through various departments at the customs
Liaise with customs and other governing authorities for any issues that will arise during clearance of cargo
Communicate with customs officials as appropriate to obtain the release of incoming or outgoing freight and resolve delays
Represent the client and company on all matters related to customs
Coordinate and follow up with clients on payments

pcs.pc_description: Perform spending analysis with all forward and reverse costs considered.
Populate data from different software like TMS, fuel purchasing systems, truckload carrier accounting systems, customs, bill of lading data, and any others.
Collect trucking spot freight rates, contracted freight trends, current truck equipment orders, and outbound and inbound data.
Compare findings to industry trends.
Prepare a scorecard and use the same for easy comparison of carrier performances based on different factors.
Substantiate findings using facts-based analysis and quantification of exposures.
Assess the effectiveness of business monitoring procedures and processes.
Shift from stagnant or point-in-time reviews to focused implementation of ongoing monitoring.
Analyse company stock and location data for optimal routing.
Identify ways to optimise "less than truckload" shipments. Inefficient truck utilisation leads to revenue leaks.
The capacity of freight vessels and trains should be utilised at least at a rate of over 70% per trip in order to maintain profitability.
Identify high-risk business areas, products, freight carriers, business lines, and geographies to focus efforts.
Analyse overall freight expenses to identify anomalies.
Utilise available infrastructure to the maximum.
Collate data from tracing and analyse the same for patterns on transit time, delays and service failures.
Allocate full capacities to orders, and plan transportation itineraries and frequency.
Provide insights to the management by developing a deeper understanding of freight expenses to identify opportunities for improvement with (efficiency and control environment).
Use a route optimisation solution to optimise delivery routes around changing traffic conditions.
Use a transportation planning solution that integrates supply chain planning and shipping execution to assess real-time risk across the supply chain.
Integrate a shipment planning window with TMS that covers projection for several days forward and order management, procurement, and supply chain optimisation solutions.
Use technologies like weatheroptics to forecast and enhance the solutions for risks related to weather conditions. This allows rerouting of vehicles to minimize the impact of weather hazards.
Choose carriers with better vehicle maintenance and safety records, which reduces the risk of transit delays due to vehicle breakdowns.
Integrate digital freight markets and brokerages into TMS, which will help optimise cost and analyse the quotes.

Choose vendors with APIs for posting loads, booking, tendering, and tracking. Carriers using digital fleet management and TMS solutions with highly automated material handling reduce the risk of lost shipments.
Identify alternate ports and CFS/ ICDs, which decrease the risk of delay. Build agility into processes so that switch ports are available if needed.

pcs.pc_description: Build market intelligence and stay current with service offerings and developments in the organisation and the industry.
Prepare and implement a sales plan for acquiring new clients.
Obtain the list of existing clients and new prospects from the Company's sales database.
Prepare sales targets and relationship strategies.
Prioritise the clients for contacting, based on the previous relationship-building calls made to each of them.
Meet clients to offer new services and take feedback for current services.
Identify clients' business needs and offer customised and bundled solutions.
Negotiate on costs, close the deal and collect organisational and payment details of the client.
Take the client's feedback before leaving.
Regularly interact with the client over the phone, through emails, or personal visits.
Address customers' queries effectively and take appropriate action on customer escalations.
Handle customer grievances such as shipment damage or tampering, extra charges levied, failure to deliver as per commitment, and delays.
Provide regular information to clients regarding new offerings, discounts, customised solutions, etc.

modules.module_title: Coordinate with government officials, vendors and contractors

pcs.pc_description: Represent the interests of the Company whenever required and manage & protect the Company's reputation.
Liaise with customs, Partner Government Agencies (PGAs), other Govt. departments, etc., and build strong professional relations with them.
Participate in advisory groups to put forth ideas/suggestions for improvements.
Discuss and review a holistic assessment of the Company's assets, facilities, equipment, and activities with stakeholders to identify security needs and threats.
Review regularly, adhere to SLA agreed to by vendors/contractors in documented contracts.
Conduct forensic audits to flag any deviation in contract awards if required, along with procurement & finance teams.
Analyse and manage insurance claim requests.
Coordinate with marketing agencies for publicity of services of the Company.
Ensure adherence to SLA agreed to by vendors/contractors in documented contracts.

Negotiate with carriers, warehouse and transport operators, customs brokers, insurance company representatives, vendors, etc., for services, preferential rates, service level agreements (SLA), payment periods, etc.
Coordinate with labour contractors and local vendors for sufficient workforce, carrier vehicle availability as per work demand.
